searchText: And a big thanks to <@!493127838757814283> who did the actual work to implement jwt support in Teku. The Lighthouse `unstable` branch is syncing the devnet-4 beacon chain. There's one change required to forgive Geth for sending a `latestValidHash` when we expect `null`, but it's working well. However, I haven't managed to get peers for Geth yet. I've specified `--bootnodes`, but to no avail. Perhaps someone has an example of a script/service that will run Geth and find peers for devnet-4? 🙏 Most likely you need to specify the network ID correctly: https://github.com/ajsutton/merge-scripts/blob/main/merge-devnet-4/startGeth.sh is the script I'm using and just got it to snap sync with teku correctly. Instant peers! Thank you 🙏 For reference, I added `--networkid=1337752` to `geth`. Now we're synced 🎉 Yeah we don't have exTrConf yet Great that it works! Great progress so far! The idea is to get more feedback from this devnet and release v2 with auth, ping features and incorporate the feedback in it. So, if things are going well then v2 should be expected early next week A file containing the secret should be the way to go, we'll adapt our implementation to that We check if its a secret (32 byte length) or a path and read that I think we should get v2 out asap, assuming *someone* has implemented it... if at all possible, next devnet should target v2 difficulty bomb is ticking I am at the same page with the next devnet running v2 spec version. Thinking about Mon/Tue for the release perf We only need the new method for v2 Will implement today Hmm I was getting signature rejected when I specified a path even though it was the same path teku was reading from. So there must be something different in how we’re loading the key.

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
The Lighthouse `unstable` branch is syncing the devnet-4 beacon chain. There's one change required to forgive Geth for sending a `latestValidHash` when we expect `null`, but it's working well.

However, I haven't managed to get peers for Geth yet. I've specified `--bootnodes`, but to no avail. Perhaps someone has an example of a script/service that will run Geth and find peers for devnet-4? 🙏

excerpts.author: ajsutton
excerpts.content: Most likely you need to specify the network ID correctly: https://github.com/ajsutton/merge-scripts/blob/main/merge-devnet-4/startGeth.sh is the script I'm using and just got it to snap sync with teku correctly.

excerpts.author: paulhauner
excerpts.content:
Instant peers! Thank you 🙏 

For reference, I added `--networkid=1337752` to `geth`.

excerpts.author: mariusvanderwijden
excerpts.content: Yeah we don't have exTrConf yet

excerpts.content: Great progress so far! The idea is to get more feedback from this devnet and release v2 with auth, ping features and incorporate the feedback in it. So, if things are going well then v2 should be expected early next week
